title: Nonprofit Trends for 2026 That Will Change Fundraising Forever
actionable_recommendations: Utilize VSSLs (Video Sales Letters) on campaign landing pages to enhance donor engagement.
Simplify the donor journey by removing friction and providing clear steps for giving.
Implement AI assistants for tasks like grant research, donor communication, and event coordination.
Automate processes such as email follow-ups and donor management using tools like Mailchimp and Zapier.
Shift sponsorship strategies to focus on activation-based involvement rather than traditional logo placement.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Proven strategies and results in fundraising coaching may vary based on individual nonprofit circumstances.
Not a guarantee of fundraising success; outcomes depend on factors like nonprofit's readiness and situation.
Claims about the effectiveness of VSSLs and other trends can fluctuate based on market changes.
intended_organization_or_user: Small nonprofits looking to improve fundraising strategies.
major_ideas: Fundraising is becoming increasingly competitive and simplistic in approach.
Effective communication with donors requires clarity and speed.
AI can be leveraged as a valuable support tool in nonprofit operations.
Automation is essential for maintaining donor engagement and operational efficiency.
Sponsorship models are evolving to require more interactive and meaningful engagement.
prerequisites: Understanding modern donor behavior and expectations.
Basic knowledge of video production to create VSSLs.
Familiarity with automation tools and their integration.
Awareness of current trends in sponsorship and donor engagement.
proposed_workflow: Identify donor pain points and streamline communication processes.
Create a VSSL addressing who is helped, why now, and what action to take next.
Integrate AI tools for repetitive tasks and donor follow-up processes.
Set up automated email sequences for new subscribers and donors.
Develop interactive sponsorship engagement strategies with potential corporate partners.
tools_templates_resources: VSSLs (Video Sales Letters) for effective communication.
AI tools like ChatGPT for grant research and communications.
Automation platforms such as Mailchimp, ManyChat, and Zapier for efficiency.
Resources for creating engaging sponsorship packages that focus on activation.
